technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with price above all major moving averages and bullish cloud, but overbought RSI/Stochastic and lack of fresh crossover signals suggest limited upside confirmation for new entry.

fundamental.summary: No detectable insider buying or institutional accumulation signals; 85 days to earnings presents minimal near-term timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (30 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite neutral AAII sentiment and negative commercial positioning, with no congressional signals to contradict.

risk.summary: Elevated VIX (29.9) combined with imminent FOMC event in 2 days creates excessive uncertainty; entry unsuitable for swing trade.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong uptrend structure with price above EMA-200, supertrend bullish, and Ichimoku cloud confirmation, combined with contrarian buy signal during fear-zone conditions, provides solid directional bias.
debate.key_bear_argument: Imminent FOMC event in 2 days with elevated VIX (29.9) and overbought oscillators (RSI-9/14, Stochastic, Williams %R) without fresh entry confirmation create unacceptable swing-trade timing risk.

decision.entry_rationale: While technical structure is strong (price above EMA-200, supertrend bullish), FOMC event in 2 days with elevated VIX (29.9) and overbought oscillators without fresh entry signals make this unsuitable for swing trading.
decision.primary_risk: Imminent FOMC monetary policy announcement combined with high volatility regime creates unacceptable event risk that outweighs technical confirmation.
